message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Asset Growth Dispersion", "construction": "Compute the standard deviation of quarterly asset growth rates over the past two years for each firm.", "rationale": "Firms with highly volatile asset growth may reflect managerial uncertainty or shifting business prospects, potentially mispriced by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D to Free Cash Flow Ratio", "construction": "Divide total R&D expense (annual) by free cash flow (annual, operating cash flow minus capital expenditures).", "rationale": "Firms investing a higher proportion of free cash flow into R&D may have more growth options underappreciated by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Late Filer Indicator", "construction": "Flag firms that file annual 10-Ks more than 90 days after fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "Late filings may signal internal problems or poor governance that investors penalize, possibly leading to subsequent mean reversion.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Insider Trading", "construction": "Sum net insider purchases (shares bought minus shares sold by officers/directors) over the past six months and divide by shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Insiders have superior firm information; net purchases may indicate undervaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Negative Analyst Revision Skew", "construction": "Calculate the skewness of analyst earnings forecast revisions over the past year for each firm.", "rationale": "Unusually negative skewness may indicate overreaction, leading to future reversals.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Operating Cost Stickiness", "construction": "Measure percent change in operating costs when revenue falls by at least 5% year-over-year; define stickiness as % cost change divided by % revenue change.", "rationale": "Firms with stickier costs may have less operational flexibility, which could be mispriced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "New Product Announcements", "construction": "Count the number of new product launches announced in press releases in the past 12 months.", "rationale": "Frequent product launches may reflect innovation undervalued by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Backlog Growth Rate", "construction": "Compute the year-over-year percentage change in order backlog as reported in 10-Ks.", "rationale": "Rising backlogs can signal underestimated future revenues and growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Initiation Surprise", "construction": "Flag firms that initiate a dividend after at least three years of no dividend; measure the amount as a percent of current earnings.", "rationale": "Unexpected dividend initiations may signal improved prospects underappreciated by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Citation Intensity", "construction": "Count the number of citations received by a firm’s patents (from USPTO data) over the past three years, scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "Firms with more highly cited patents may possess valuable intellectual property not fully reflected in current prices.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
